false_positives.comment: False positive: this cast addresses the NUL-terminated candidate text immediately after WordNode. AddWord copies candidate characters into that payload in the zero-initialized arena; WordList::Init assigns strcmp to WL_strcmp in both branches, so CompareNode consumes the payload as a character string. GetList later copies the same text into the newline-separated AutoCShow string. The owning arena already uses std::byte; this expression deliberately retrieves its character payload, not an arbitrary object representation.
